summary: JIADE Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a share consolidation (10:1) and a change in authorized share capital, including a capital reduction, share issuance, repurchase, and cancellation. These are routine corporate actions aimed at adjusting par value, share count, and authorized capital, with no acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The actions were approved by the board and shareholders, and the shares will trade post-consolidation on Nasdaq under the same symbol. No special situation is present.
